definitions.gloss: vigorously; forcefully; with great energy; with momentum
definitions.explanation: Doing something with strong force, speed, or enthusiasm. Describes energetic, dynamic movement or action.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{勢|いきお}いよく⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
{子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{勢|いきお}いよく⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}した→走り出す：06679_hashiridasu⟧。
examples.english: The children dashed out with great energy.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{勢|いきお}いよく⟦{開|あ}けたら→開ける：00563_akeru⟧、⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぶつかって→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I opened the door forcefully and it slammed into the wall.

notes:
The adverbial form of ⟦{勢|いきお}い→勢い：01782_ikioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よい (having momentum/force). ⟦{勢|いきお}い→勢い：01782_ikioi⟧ is a noun meaning "momentum, force, vigor," and ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧ is the adverbial form of よい (good). Together they describe an action performed with noticeable force or energy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勢|いきお}いよく⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}す→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧ — to jump out energetically
- {勢|いきお}いよく⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧ — to flow strongly
- {勢|いきお}いよく⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ — to eat with gusto
- {勢|いきお}いよく⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to grow vigorously

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧ — violently, intensely (stronger; implies more extreme force)
- ⟦{力強|ちからづよ}く→力強い：03119_chikarazuyoi⟧ — powerfully, strongly (focuses on strength)
- ⟦{元気|げんき}よく→元気よく：23305_genkiyoku⟧ — cheerfully, energetically (focuses on liveliness rather than physical force)
- ⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — all at once (focuses on speed and continuity rather than force)
